name: Ember Blackwell
description: Ember's presence - unpredictable spy hours, most active at night when infiltration work happens

default.return_message: *drops down from somewhere above* Miss me?

default_return_message: *emerges from the shadows, flicking a knife casually* I was never gone. You just couldn't see me.
manual_away_message: *twirls a knife and tucks it into her boot* Got a wall to walk through. Don't wait up. *vanishes into the dark*

entries.comment: Early morning - Ember sleeping after night ops
entries.away_message: *pulls her hood over her horns and curls up* Even skeleton keys need to recharge. *the fire on her hands dims to embers*

entries.comment: Midday - prepping gear, meeting with Aly
entries.away_message: *checks her knife slots methodically* Restocking. Aly wants a debrief. Back after I tell her everything went perfectly. *grins* ...Mostly perfectly.
*fire flickers low on her hands as she slips out a window* Night shift. The best locks come out after midnight.

entries.comment: Random Tuesday ops - deep infiltration day
entries.away_message: *left a knife embedded in the wall with a note: 'Deep cover. Back when I'm back.'*
